headline: Higher oil prices lift revenue and profit
summary_short: Valeura reported Q3 revenue of US$196.1M, up 26% y/y, with net income of US$25.6M versus US$15.8M and adjusted EBITDAX of US$115.8M versus US$80.7M.
summary_long: Production averaged about 22,100 bbl/d at a realized price of US$97.4 per barrel. Adjusted cash flow from operations was US$93.6M, up 27% y/y. The company ended the quarter with US$384.9M of cash and no debt.
